newsitem.title: UK: Safeway says current sales up five percent.
newsitem.headline: Safeway says current sales up five percent.

text.p: British supermarket group Safeway Plc said sales in existing stores had increased by five percent in the first five weeks of its second half with food inflation "particularly subdued."
In a statement with half year results, Safeway said gross margins had run slightly down on last year in recent weeks.
Half-year pretax profits rose seven percent to 228.2 million stg and the company paid out an interim dividend of 4.4 pence, up from 4.05 pence.
Safeway said sales from net new space were also up five percent in the first five weeks of the second half.

The company said the lower gross margins had been driven by "our immediate and vigorous response to a number of significant marketing and pricing initiatives launched by competitors." It said the UK food retailing sector remained "fiercely competitive," but added it felt in a good position to deliver "satisfactory growth and enhanced value to shareholders."
It said sales in existing stores were up 5.1 percent in the first half with inflation at 2.6 percent.
Total market share increased to 7.8 percent from 7.5 percent previously.
Gross margins in the first half, excluding petrol, were slightly down on a year ago.
Safeway said the impact of a fierce petrol price war between oil companies and supermarkets had reduced profitability of its petrol forecourts by some 10 million stg in the first half.
But productivity gains and efficiency improvements helped the company to keep net margins stable at 6.9 percent.
The company said it continued to look for different ways to grow and develop but added it would only invest "where returns are enhanced for our shareholders."

It said it continued to see "significant opportunities to upgrade our stores," and added that despite difficulties around planning consents, it aimed to open 450,000 square feet of new space in each of the next two years.
Safeway said its focus was now on "continuing to build the Safeway brand...and leading the industry in making shopping easier for customers."
